overall_notes: The paper focuses on prosody-aware generative spoken language modeling. It evaluates speech continuation using both automatic metrics (NLL, MAE, BLEU, etc.) and human evaluation (MOS, M-MOS, P-MOS). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of some irrelevant items.
